texts.heroTitle: Where Little Learners Grow with Confidence
texts.heroLead: A nurturing, structured preschool experience in a warm, home-like setting where every child is known, supported, and prepared for what comes next.
texts.heroHighlight2: 🐰 One Small Class, More One-on-One Attention! 💛
texts.introKicker: Looking for a nurturing place where your child will truly learn, grow, and thrive?
texts.introTitle: Small, Structured Preschool Care With Big Heart
texts.introBody: At Cottontail Childcare & Education, we offer a small, structured preschool experience in a warm, home-like setting so every child gets the attention they deserve.
texts.programsTitle: Real Preschool Learning in a Calm, Caring Setting
texts.programsBody: Your child receives more than supervision here. Each day blends structured preschool learning, social-emotional growth, and individualized support so children build confidence while preparing for kindergarten.
texts.benefit1Body: With a maximum of 6 children, each child receives individual support, more learning time, and stronger confidence.
texts.benefit2Body: Children work on letter sounds, early reading, writing, name tracing, counting, numbers, and early math in age-appropriate ways.
texts.benefit3Body: Children thrive in calm routines, organized learning spaces, and a setting focused on safety, health, and kindness.
texts.benefit4Body: Families receive photos, learning updates, and daily highlights so they stay connected to each child's day.
texts.spaceTitle: A Bright Space for Learning and Play
texts.spaceBody: Cottontail is designed to feel calm, clean, and inviting, with room for reading, creative play, preschool activities, and small-group learning.
texts.galleryBody: From reading and preschool activities to creative play and outdoor time, these moments show the kind of warm, engaged days children enjoy here.
texts.trust1Body: Children benefit from guidance shaped by real classroom experience and a clear understanding of kindergarten readiness.
texts.trust2Body: CPR and First Aid certified, background checked, and committed to a safe, steady environment families can trust.
texts.trust3Body: As a mother of two, the care here is rooted in connection, patience, and the kind of attention every child deserves.
texts.aboutTitle: A Place Where Children Feel Safe, Loved, and Excited to Learn
texts.aboutBody1: At Cottontail Childcare & Education, we create a place where children feel safe, loved, and excited to learn. Our days are intentionally balanced so children keep growing academically, socially, and emotionally.
texts.aboutBody2: The goal is simple: every child leaves feeling more confident, more capable, and more ready for kindergarten.
texts.pricingBody: One straightforward weekly rate for families who want a small-group setting with personalized attention and real preschool learning.
texts.ctaTitle: Schedule a Tour Before Spots Fill
texts.ctaBody: We only accept 6 children. Once spots are filled, enrollment closes.

testimonials.name: Michaela Miller-Merritts
testimonials.text:
Great price
We could not be more grateful for Mrs. Kristel and Cottontail Childcare. My little one is absolutely thriving under her care. I am by all definitions a helicopter mom. I am extremely particular about who watches my daughter and what atmosphere she is immersed in. My mother ran an in-home preschool and I refused to bring my daughter anywhere that did not meet the standards I witnessed my mother uphold. The minute we met Kristel I knew that her childcare program was here my little one belonged. My daughter immediately warmed up to Kristel and actively talks about her day and all of the wonderful things she has learned.

I am very impressed by the program at Cottontail. Their daily lessons are carefully planned and engaging. We currently have several of my daughter projects handing on our kitchen wall. My daughter is a fast learner and needs to be constantly challenged and encouraged and she receives exactly that. Kristel also sends updates throughout the day of her mood, engagement with the program, and play time. As a mother who simply cannot stop thinking about her daughter, these updates bring me joy every day. I look forward to seeing my little one having a wonderful day. Kristel also have a wonderful potty-training program! My little one took to potty-training well and at 2.5yrs old, she is 90% potty trained (Only wet at night). Kristel uses positive reinforcement to help the children gain confidence.

The environment is very clean and tidy. Kristel keeps a clean home and instills cleanliness with the children as well. Safety is a priority and she does an excellent job of teaching the children safe habits. She also fosters a supportive environment. The children are taught to play nicely and to cheer each other on during lessons. Kristel openly communicates with my husband and me any concerns she has regarding my daughter's behavior and she tries to ensure there is consistency regarding instruction so my little one can feel more balanced between daycare and home.

My little one is 2.5yrs old and we have every intention of remaining at Cottontail until she goes to Kindergarten. The small classroom size is a huge factor for us. My daughter receives individualized attention and is not simply "watched". I also strongly believe the price point is very reasonable for all of the services we receive.

There are one hundred different things I am grateful for in my life. Mrs. Kristel and Cottontail Childcare & Education is absolutely one of those things.

testimonials.name: Jennifer Borchers
testimonials.text: Kristel at Cottontail Childcare & Education provides outstanding care and education. Her approach is warm, professional, and personalized for each child. The small group size makes it a unique and engaging learning experience. I definitely recommend her services.

testimonials.name: Becca Carder
testimonials.text: Cottontail Childcare & Education is absolutely fantastic! My daughter has been attending for an almost a month now, and I've seen such positive growth in her. The facility is always clean and welcoming, and the activities are engaging and age-appropriate. Miss Kristel is an exceptional teacher – she's patient, kind, and truly cares about each child's development. I appreciate the daily updates and photos that keep me connected throughout the day. Knowing Bentlee is in such a nurturing and educational environment gives me complete peace of mind. I highly recommend Cottontail to any parent looking for top-notch childcare!

testimonials.name: Jordan Palmer
testimonials.text: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ We absolutely love Cottontail Childcare & Education! My 2.5-year-old son started going at the end of April, and I can’t say enough good things about our experience. Kristel has created such a warm, welcoming, and thoughtfully designed space for little ones. Her home and play areas are beautiful, and there’s a perfect mix of learning activities and free play—which my son thrives on! As someone with a background in psychology/social work and experience working with CPS, I’m very particular about who I trust with my child. I felt completely at ease with Kristel from the very beginning. She’s kind, attentive, and you can tell she genuinely loves what she does. My son has already learned so much, and he looks forward to going every day. It brings me so much peace knowing he’s in such good hands. If you’re looking for childcare or a preschool in the Springboro area, I can’t recommend Cottontail enough!

testimonials.name: Lindsay Riddle-Whitt
testimonials.text: Cotton Tail Education has been an absolute blessing for our family! From the moment we walked in, we could tell this was a warm, loving, and enriching environment for children. Mrs. Kristel is an incredible teacher and caregiver—her passion for early childhood education shines through in everything she does. Since our daughter started here, we’ve been amazed at how much she has learned and grown. Every day, she comes home excited to share new things, whether it’s letters, numbers, or the fun activities they do. Beyond academics, we can tell she truly feels loved and nurtured, which gives us so much peace of mind. The space itself is immaculate, incredibly well-organized, and thoughtfully designed for little learners. There’s plenty of room for play, exploration, and hands-on learning, making it the perfect environment for children to thrive. It’s clear that Mrs. Kristel puts her heart into every detail, and we are beyond grateful to have found this gem. If you’re looking for a safe, loving, and highly educational place for your child, Cotton Tail Education is the best choice. We cannot recommend Mrs. Kristel enough!

testimonials.name: Kyle Whitt
testimonials.text: I couldn’t be more impressed with Kristal and Cottontail Childcare & Education. Her home is immaculate; clean and safe with ample room for the kids to play and learn. Kristal is extremely kind and easy to work with. Her prices are better than any other daycare around. She runs the Daycare through the Lillio app and she sends photos and updates to you throughout the day which is really cool. Kristal has been and Godsend for our family and our 2-year-old daughter adores her. You won’t find better childcare than this, Kristal is the best.

testimonials.name: Destiny Mann
testimonials.text: Kristel is amazing with my two boys. They love everyday they go to her and always want to go back. She provides a warm nurturing environment for them to learn and grow. She teaches them so much everyday. I will always recommend her to anyone that needs a sitter for toddlers.

testimonials.name: Mayra Vazquez
testimonials.text: The atmosphere at Cottontail is both welcoming and inspiring. Kristel fosters an environment where learning is encouraged in a playful, and enjoyable way. A perfect place for growth and development.

testimonials.name: Richard Coning
testimonials.text: Kristel is fantastic! She provideds one on one care and education. Highly reccomend for anyone seeking high quality personalized childcare.

testimonials.name: Robyn
testimonials.text: I highly recommend Cottontail Childcare & Education! I've known Kristel for years & she is great with children. She is very professional, as well as safe, clean, & organized. She will keep your child active & engaged in learning, and they will have a fun & happy time!

testimonials.name: Sarah Miller
testimonials.text: Kristel, the owner of Cottontail Childcare & Education. Is simply amazing with kids! She creates a fun , exciting, and clean environment where children thrive. Her passion for teaching and making a positive difference in children's lives truly shines through in every aspect of her care. I highly recommend Kristel!
